description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon3d/rules/central_D_lev_zero_grad_bc driven by problems/latlon3d_advection_vertical_zero_grad.esm — the vertical (lev) analogue of advection_1d_nonuniform_zero_grad with passive lon (NLON=8) and lat (NLAT=5) axes, on a quadratic-stretch non-uniform vertical. The problem is loaded once per resolution binding NLEV; the pe edge array and derived zc centers re-derive from the NLEV name each rebinding. Forced-steady manufactured solution cos(pi z); the t=0.1 drift is the operator truncation on the stretched mesh, second-order in L2 (supraconvergence). expected_order 2.0; order_tolerance 0.25 (same as the 1-D nonuniform sibling).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
